title: No thorns sound effect
description: This resource pack removes the thorns enchantement's sound effect.
body:
Are you tired of the annoying thorns enchantement sound effect in Minecraft? This resource pack removes it completely, giving you a smoother and less distracting experience during combat. Whether you're grinding PvP, practicing your skills, or simply enjoying the game, you won't have to deal with the constant Thorns noise anymore. Enjoy cleaner fights, clearer audio, and a more peaceful Minecraft experience.

This resource pack has only been tested in 1.21.11. It should work in other versions, but I am not guaranteeing anything.

Curseforge version:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/no-thorns-sound-effect
